environment: Dedicated Docker-in-Docker container on Hetzner, no host Docker socket or external published ports
prerequisites: Fresh attachment volume ownership required UID 65532; owner applied this in the staging container
Alpine staging needed GNU coreutils for the existing df guard; installed before the installation measurement
limitations: Ephemeral staging signing key; production trust provisioning remains open
Disk figures sample the shared host filesystem, so other host activity can affect them
Rollback and the final reorganized Compose runtime require subsequent staging verification
